description: Transfer to third country relies on Article 49 derogation but specific situation and necessity are not documented. Derogations are limited to specific situations and must be documented with justification.
applicability: Applicable when transfers occur without adequacy or safeguards, relying on derogations. Must be occasional, necessary, and documented. Not available for systematic or large-scale transfers.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of transfers without adequacy or safeguards and absence of derogation justification documentation.

sources.title: GDPR - Regulation (EU) 2016/679
sources.section: Chapter V - Transfers to Third Countries
